name: crowd
//: A row of people. The order is the sound: the left end is the low end, so it stands heaviest — both feet planted, slow — and the right end is the top of the range, where the movement is quick and light. The kick is a hit, which is why the one throwing a kick stands with the bass. The pair in the middle is the one everybody else is turned towards.
//heights: The dot heights a mark is baked at, and the stroke it comes out with at each. See cmd/spindle-marks.
//faces: Turned in on the row: everything past the middle is drawn the other way round, so the two halves look at each other. A row of people all facing one way is a queue.
